artifact_observations.reasoning: The internal components in the battery bay are nonsensical. The 'batteries' lack defined cylindrical geometry and appear to melt into the casing. The contacts and springs are structurally incoherent and look like melted plastic rather than metal.
The wireframe/line drawings in the background have inconsistent perspective lines and warped proportions compared to the photorealistic foreground object.
Text on the screen is illegible smudges rather than crisp pixels. Text in the background diagrams is simulated scribbles, not readable characters.
The tip of the floating stylus lacks sharp definition and seems to slightly blur/fuse with the white background. The grip of the hand on the device shows minor edge bleeding.
